title: Finish a hand-rolled debounce and throttle
acceptanceCriteria: `debounce` runs `fn` once, `wait` ms after the last call, with the **last** call's arguments
`debounce` passes `fn` the `this` it was called with
`debounced.cancel()` drops a pending run for good: it never fires, and a later `flush()` has nothing to run
`debounced.flush()` runs a pending call immediately and exactly once, and does nothing when nothing is pending
`throttle` runs the first call immediately and never runs twice within `wait`
`throttle`'s trailing run uses the **latest** arguments, and a single call runs only once
